words: It's a solid start, but we can and should do much better. I would like to get to a point where we can generate and parameterize characters that are similar quality to what we currently have.
note: Our own generator (person.py, the character spike) accepted as the base for characters, not as the bar. The quality target is the VRoid control (Sendagaya Shino) close up, from a parameterized tool of our own (docs/SMALL_CITY.md decision 2). Track char-2 works from it in passes.
